claims.quote: Badis blosyrus is a badid from western Assam and northern West Bengal in India, in the Brahmaputra drainage.
The type series was collected close to the town of Raimana in western Assam state, northern India and at the time represented the only known population of the species.

It has since been collected in the nearby Buxa (often spelled 'Buxar') National Park, West Bengal state, from the Raidak River, a tributary of the Brahmaputra rising in Bhutan, and from streams of the western Garo Hills in Meghalaya state, south of the main Brahmaputra channel (tentative identifications).
